mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We currently have overcast skies near Verona Area High School with a temperature of 38 degrees that feels like 29. The space station passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, candidate information packets for all four Aldermanic Districts in the 2027 Spring Election are now available from the City Clerk, with paperwork due by January 5th. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, with the first installment due January 31st.

For local events, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's or Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, ART House 360 opens its doors for Thursday night events, and looking ahead to Saturday, November 28th, check out The Crafty Fair at ART House 360.
In police news, officers responded on Monday, November 9th to a vehicle swerving drastically on US Highway 18 151, resulting in the arrest of a 61-year-old man for a third offence O W I.
Over at Culver's, today's delicious flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store is currently open, so stop by before 10:00 PM to get your treat.
